nusmp.page.book_spatial.dimensional_armo: Dimensional Armour - for 20 s the Gate Garb wraps you: a pearl and void set with gate rings on the shoulders, hips and knees, a gate wheel behind your back. A blow aimed at you may fall through a gate and miss (15 to 35 percent by EP); the rest are cut by a fifth.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.gate_strike: Gate Strike - a rift opens behind the foe you look at and the cut comes out of it: 14 x EP scale spatial damage that ignores 40 percent of their armour, and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.gate_swap: Gate Swap - two gates open and you trade places with the foe or ally you look at (20 blocks). A foe is slowed; a boss is too heavy for a gate and is only shaken.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.dimension_collap: Dimension Collapse - space folds in on the aimed point. For two seconds everything within 6 blocks (scaled by the grimoire and EP) is dragged in, then the fold shuts for 22 x EP scale spatial damage. Bosses are pulled a third as hard and their damage is capped.
nusmp.spatial.fell_through: The blow falls through a gate.
nusmp.spatial.too_heavy: It is too heavy for a gate: it is only shaken.
